# Voice Wall

> Voice Wall 发声墙 is an independent AI journal and the home of the Anthropic Protest File. Its Miami edition is available in Chinese, English and Spanish.

The AI journal publishes dated articles with source links on model releases, platform policies and the AI industry. The Anthropic archive gathers documented controversies involving Claude, Claude Code, platform access, privacy, billing and training data. The public voice wall carries reader comments and a petition.

## Miami edition

- [中文首页](https://anti-anthropic.vercel.app/) · [AI 发展手记](https://anti-anthropic.vercel.app/articles)
- [English home](https://anti-anthropic.vercel.app/en) · [AI journal](https://anti-anthropic.vercel.app/en/articles)
- [Inicio en español](https://anti-anthropic.vercel.app/es) · [Revista de IA](https://anti-anthropic.vercel.app/es/articles)
